name: Earth biosphere (reference record)
description: The life-sustaining zone of Earth, held as one reference case for waste-cycling and gradient use. Every evidence line below is either a quote from a source fetched on 2026-11-24 or is marked NOT OPENED. The framing lines are the owner's, from the work order 'Earth-scale reference record', and are marked as such.
origin: owner's work order 'LID: Earth-scale reference record', 2026-11-24

scope.statement: life-sustaining zone, not planetary energy balance

energy_boundary.statement: sunlight in, heat out (stated, set aside)

evidence.reason: stated by the order and set aside by the order; no source was looked for

evidence.quote: The earliest life forms on our planet so far observed to have existed, are microbes that left signals of their presence in rocks ~ 3.6 Ga
evidence.reads: age of the earliest observed life: this source gives ~3.6 Ga, not ~3.8. The order's ~3.8 Gyr and this ~3.6 Ga are both kept; they are not reconciled here.

evidence.reason: no fetched source gives ~3.8 Gyr. A 2003 abstract (PMID 12594918) seen in a search listing used '3.8 Gyr' inside a hypothesis about the first cells; the listing was not kept and a second fetch failed, so it is not quoted.

control_group.statement: same star, no recycling network observed

evidence.quote: However, from the perspective of the Solar System, Earth appears unique as the only planet known to support life.
evidence.reads: no life known on another Solar System planet. This is not the same statement as 'no recycling network observed'.

evidence.reason: no source was opened on the Moon as a control case, or on the absence of a recycling network on the Moon, Mars or Venus. The pages tried for this (en.wikipedia.org, science.nasa.gov) did not answer from this machine; no value is written from recall.

evidence.quote: Following the LOME, the Silurian era (~443 to 420 Ma) ( 9 ) comprised a 23-million-year recovery interval
evidence.reads: recovery after one of the five (Late Ordovician), which the same article calls a "Big Five" event.

evidence.quote: The EDME was also followed by a similarly prolonged Mississippian (359 to 323 Ma) ( 9 ) recovery interval

evidence.reason: no source was opened that lists all five mass extinctions or describes recovery after the other three; the count 5 is the order's

evidence.line: chemotrophic systems without sunlight (e.g. Movile Cave, deep vents)

evidence.quote: Movile Cave (SE Romania) is a chemoautotrophically-based ecosystem fed by hydrogen sulfide-rich groundwater serving as a primary energy source analogous to the deep-sea hydrothermal ecosystems.
The Movile Cave (SE Romania) was the first to be mentioned as defying the conventional view of subterranean ecosystems as supported by aboveground photosynthesis.
The most studied chemoautotrophically-based ecosystems are deep-sea hydrothermal vents and cold seeps
evidence.reads: deep vents named as chemoautotrophically-based ecosystems, in the Movile Cave article. No article about a vent ecosystem was opened.

evidence.reason: no primary source on a deep-sea vent ecosystem was opened
